name: Basedash
description:
Basedash is an AI-native BI platform. This connector lets Claude query governed company data, list available sources, and create, edit, list, or retrieve dashboards and charts — with the same workspace permissions as the Basedash app.

Connect once with browser OAuth (no API keys). Claude can:
• Ask plain-English questions of live databases, warehouses, and SaaS sources
• Discover which data sources the signed-in user can access
• Create or edit dashboards and charts from natural-language instructions
• List and open existing dashboards and charts, including durable Basedash URLs and chart screenshots when available

Every tool call enforces Basedash access controls. If an account cannot see a source, dashboard, or chart in Basedash, the connector will not expose it. Dashboard/chart reads use mcp:dashboards:read; creates/edits use mcp:chat:ask and mcp:dashboards:write.

Requires a Basedash account and at least one connected data source. Setup: https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/mcp-server

_published_faq.name: How do I add Basedash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Basedash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://charts.basedash.com/api/public/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Basedash MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basedash provides these MCP tools: ask_question, create_chart, create_dashboard, edit_chart, edit_dashboard, get_chart, get_dashboard, get_data_sources, list_charts, and list_dashboards.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Basedash?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Basedash in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Basedash requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Basedash is developed by Basedash Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
